English: Herb Patch
A small, rough plot where hardy herbs and wild greens are cultivated for practical use by the castles first settlers.
Vegetable Plot
Simple rows of vegetables, tended by castle folk, yielding improved produce and modest support for the garrison.
Fruit Orchard
Orchards of apples, pears, and plums bring increased bounty, improving local supplies and morale.
Walled Garden
A secure, cultivated garden enclosed by stone walls, providing peace, security, and a mark of status.
Decorative Garden
An elegant display of hedges and flowers, enhancing the prestige and dignity of the castle.
Fountain Terrace
A stately terrace with flowing fountains and sculpted basins, a symbol of wealth and refined taste.
Rose Garden
A lavish collection of rose beds and trellises, renowned throughout the realm, making the castle a place of beauty and romance.
Maze Garden
A grand hedge maze, both a delight for guests and a subtle layer of defense for the inner keep.
Pavilion Garden
Magnificent pavilions for feasts and gatherings, set amidst lush grounds, strengthening alliances and the lords prestige.
Royal Courtyard
A regal courtyard of unrivaled grandeur, the heart of diplomatic, administrative, and ceremonial life for the castle and its realm.
